## 为什么用极坐标

 <span style="mso-spacerun:'yes';font-family:宋体;mso-ascii-font-family:Calibri;
mso-hansi-font-family:Calibri;mso-bidi-font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10.5000pt;
mso-font-kerning:1.0000pt;"><strike><font face="宋体">&nbsp;极坐标系（</font><font face="Calibri">polar coordinate system</font><font face="宋体">）是平面上的一种坐标系统。选定平面内一点</font><font face="Calibri">O</font></strike><font face="宋体"><strike>作为极点......&nbsp;</strike></font></span> 

<span style="mso-spacerun:'yes';font-family:宋体;mso-ascii-font-family:Calibri;
mso-hansi-font-family:Calibri;mso-bidi-font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10.5000pt;
mso-font-kerning:1.0000pt;"><font face="宋体">简单来说，眼睛或瞳孔是一个圆形的结构，而我们想要的动态高光效果是自中心向外辐射的，极坐标的“r”和“θ”恰好能可以非常自然控制高光的旋转和向外辐射</font></span>

<span style="mso-spacerun:'yes';font-family:宋体;mso-ascii-font-family:Calibri;
mso-hansi-font-family:Calibri;mso-bidi-font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10.5000pt;
mso-font-kerning:1.0000pt;"><font face="宋体">而标准的平面直角坐标系UV坐标只能沿着X、Y两个方向平移或扭曲，不适合这种圆形的动态效果</font></span>

<span style="mso-spacerun:'yes';font-family:宋体;mso-ascii-font-family:Calibri;
mso-hansi-font-family:Calibri;mso-bidi-font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10.5000pt;
mso-font-kerning:1.0000pt;"><font face="宋体"><br></font></span>

## 效果实现

要还原这个效果其实非常简单，将UV从笛卡尔坐标系转换到极坐标就行了，同时再引入一些变量来做强度、速度、扰动即可

![](data:image/png;base64,)

            *<span style="font-size: 12px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 完整的节点图</span>*

  

  

详细讲解一下

  

首先，拿到Texcoord后要先对其进行中心偏移，减去0.5；如不进行偏移，极坐标中心就会落在左下角 

UV' = UV - <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span>

  

<span style="font-size: 14px;">中心偏移完后，就可以计算“r”和“θ”了</span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;">对于“r”虚幻5内置了一个节点“length”可以直接使用，而“θ”就要自己用“custom”节点来计算了</span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;">输入UV，使用atan2计算方位角，然后再“*(1.0/(2.0*pi))”，再加上“0.5”，就可以得到一个[0,1]的值</span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;">为什么要“</span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">*(1.0/(2.0*pi)) + 0.5”呢？</span>

<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">其实很简单，再使用atan2计算方位角后，我们得到了一个值，范围是[-Π，Π]，而这个值不能就这样直接用，所以要对其进行重映射，先进行的“</span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">*(1.0/(2.0*pi))”计算其实等价于“*&nbsp;</span> 0.159154943<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">”</span>或者<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">“</span>theta/(2\*3.1415926)<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 10.5pt;">”，也就是将范围从</span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">[-Π，Π]映射到[-0.5,0.5]，这下就显而易见“+0.5”后我们就得到了一个范围是[0,1]的值</span>

<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;"><br></span>

<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">至此，我们需要的两个值“r</span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">”</span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">和“θ”就出来了，后续就是对其添加循环、旋转、扰动了，简单讲解一下</span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;">Time 使其动起来，然后 Frac 使其在[0,1]循环，EyeEff_Speed 控制其速度，而将 EyeEff_Speed 除以10是为了便于调参数</span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;">EyeEff_intensity 则是影响 Time 做出来的循环动画的流动方向，</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">从而形成向内/向外连续流动的效果</span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">EyeEff_RotationSpeed 则是控制其自转速度，同样</span></span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">除以2是为了便于调参数</span></span>

<span style="font-size: 14px;">而扰动则</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">是利用&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">“</span>Sin<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">”</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 14px;">正弦波对极坐标中的角度&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">“</span>θ&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">”</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">进行偏移，使原本规则的旋转产生波动和扭曲</span></span>

  

最后，将最终的两个变量<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">“</span>Append<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">”，作为UV输入到贴图中，就可以得到这个动态高光效果了</span>

<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;"><br></span>

<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: 14px;">最后附上完整代码：</span>

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> p = UV - <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span>;

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> r = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">length</span>(p);

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> theta =<span style="color: #dcdcaa;">atan2</span>(p.y, p.x)

            / (<span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.0</span> \* PI)

            + <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.5</span>;

  

<span style="color: #6a9955;">// Distortion</span>

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> wave1 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">sin</span>(

      r \* DistortionFrequency \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.0</span> \* PI

    + theta \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">3.0</span> \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.0</span> \* PI

    - Time \* DistortionSpeed

);

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> wave2 = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">sin</span>(

      r \* DistortionFrequency \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">1.73</span> \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.0</span> \* PI

    - theta \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">5.0</span> \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.0</span> \* PI

    + Time \* DistortionSpeed \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.73</span>

);

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> distortedTheta =

    theta

    + (wave1 \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.65</span> + wave2 \* <span style="color: #b5cea8;">0.35</span>)

    \* DistortionAmount;

  

<span style="color: #6a9955;">// Animated Polar UV</span>

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> U = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(

    Time \* EyeEff\_Speed / <span style="color: #b5cea8;">10.0</span>

    - r \* EyeEff\_Intensity / <span style="color: #b5cea8;">10.0</span>

);

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float</span> V = <span style="color: #dcdcaa;">frac</span>(

    distortedTheta

    + Time \* EyeEff\_RotationSpeed / <span style="color: #b5cea8;">2.0</span>

);

  

<span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span> EffectUV = <span style="color: #569cd6;">float2</span>(U, V);
